item.title: Park Vista Football Team Targets State Playoffs After Strong 2025 Finish
item.description: Park Vista Community High School's Cobras are building on momentum from winning four of their last five games in 2025 as they aim for the state playoffs this season.

item.title: Women's Professional Baseball League Unveils Team Names and Logos
item.description: The Women's Professional Baseball League announced the nicknames and logos of its four teams ahead of the inaugural season starting August 1 in Springfield, Illinois.

item.title: U.S. vs Belgium World Cup Match Draws Record 30 Million Viewers
item.description: Monday's United States-Belgium World Cup match became the most-watched soccer telecast in U.S. history with more than 30 million viewers tuning in.

item.title: Lionel Messi Leads Argentina to Dramatic 3-2 Comeback Win Over Egypt
item.description: Argentina rallied from a 2-0 deficit in the final 11 minutes to defeat Egypt 3-2 on Tuesday, with Lionel Messi scoring his eighth goal of the World Cup.

item.title: Karolina Muchova Defeats Coco Gauff to Reach Wimbledon Final
item.description: Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's Wimbledon run with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 victory Thursday that concluded with a dramatic tiebreaker on Centre Court.

item.description:
The 18th Annual Treasure Coast Seafood Festival will return to Vero Beach this November, according to Under The Sun Promotions, Inc.

item.title: Neighbors push back on proposed 85-acre Indrio Town Center development near I-95 in St. Lucie County
item.description: A proposed 85-acre development off Indrio Road and Russakis Road in St. Lucie County is moving closer to reality, but neighbors say it will transform the area's rural character.

item.title: Fort Pierce art teacher shot and killed; family member arrested in connection with death
item.description: Andre Leonard Barnes, a 66-year-old art teacher, was shot and killed Tuesday afternoon near the 2700 block of Essex Drive in Fort Pierce.

item.title: Port St. Lucie ranked No. 67 most stressed city in the US according to WalletHub study
item.description: A new study released this month by WalletHub examined stress in cities across the US. Port St. Lucie was ranked as the 67th most stressed city in the nation.
